pov: 第一人称（Tris 叙述，“我”）+ 一般现在时

facts.event: Shawn 带 Tris 走后部货梯出楼；离开时他告诉她当时是六点（six o’clock），距她抵达 Erudite 总部正好一小时。
facts.text: Instead he takes me to a freight elevator at the back of the building, which lets me out in a hallway that will take me to the alley. When he turns to leave, I ask him for the time, and he tells me it’s six o’clock—an hour after I first arrived in Erudite headquarters.

facts.event: Tris 所在的走廊气味像垃圾；她快步走进巷子，看见巷尾一个黑影，那人转身走向街道时露出侧脸——是 Dauntless 首领 Eric。
facts.text: The hallway I’m in smells like garbage. I hurry into the alley and see a dark figure at the end of it. When he turns to walk down the street, I see the side of his face. It’s Eric, the Dauntless leader.

facts.event: Tris 再次疑惑：为何一名 Dauntless 首领——且不是官方代表 Max Young——独自去见 Jeanine Matthews；随即她发现 Eric 手上多了原先没有的东西。
facts.text: I wonder, again, what he’s doing here. Why is a Dauntless leader—a Dauntless leader other than Max Young, their official representative—meeting with Jeanine Matthews by himself? This falls outside my mission to get close to Evelyn, but a moment later my breath catches as I realize he’s carrying something he wasn’t before.

facts.event: Tris 看不出 Eric 正插回枪套的枪是不是侧面带珠光条纹的 needle gun，还是从武器墙取走的致命武器；Dauntless 带枪本身并不稀奇。
facts.receivers: the gun (needle gun or lethal weapon)
facts.text: It’s not unusual for a Dauntless to be armed. But I can’t tell whether the gun he’s now holstering has the iridescent stripe of a needle gun on its side . . . or if it’s a lethal weapon, taken from the wall.

facts.event: Tris 承认自己一直假定 Choosing Ceremony 袭击与“即将到来的一切”背后是 factionless，却从未想过能接触到武器墙的人不止 factionless。
facts.receivers: the factionless / the weapons at the wall
facts.text: I’ve been assuming it was the factionless at the heart of the Choosing Ceremony attack, at the heart of whatever’s coming, the whole time. I never considered that the factionless aren’t the only ones with access to the weapons at the wall.

facts.event: Tris 走到车厢前端，敲开凹陷的墙板；里面的应急包几乎空了，唯一的黑色衣物是一件巨大的黑色 T 恤。
facts.text: I head straight for the front of the car, then pound on the dented wall panel so it opens. The bag inside it is almost empty, and the only black clothing I find inside it is a huge black T-shirt.

facts.event: Eric 与另一人交谈时停顿；对方开口时 Tris 完全听不见——她推断那人声音更高，也许是女孩，或只是说话没这么大声。
facts.text: He pauses as the other person speaks. I can’t hear them at all, which must mean they have a higher voice—a girl, maybe? Or just someone who’s not talking as loud.

facts.event: 一只手抓住 Tris 的肩把她拽转过来；Eric 将她推到石墙上，手臂像铁条横在她胸前，近得她能闻到他呼吸的气味。
facts.text: Then a hand grabs my shoulder and wrenches me around. I gasp at the pain of the movement, and then Eric is shoving me up against the stone wall, his arm like a metal bar across my chest. He’s so close I can smell his breath.

relations: Shawn 从后部货梯送 Tris 出 Erudite 总部，时间是六点，距她抵达正好一小时。
Tris 在一条气味像垃圾的巷子里看见 Eric，并发现他手上多了一件东西（随后确认是枪）。
Eric 独自与 Jeanine Matthews 会面，而 Dauntless 的官方代表本应是 Max Young。
Tris 无法断定 Eric 的枪是 needle gun 还是从武器墙取走的致命武器。
由此 Tris 动摇原先的判断：能接触武器墙的不止 factionless，Choosing Ceremony 袭击未必是 factionless 所为。
Tris 在第四节车厢（存有 factionless 应急包）取走一件巨大黑 T 恤换装，把 Erudite 蓝裙塞进包里。
Eric 与一名声音更高、听不清的第三人密谈，Tris 只能听到 Eric 的话。
Eric 在 Pit 边把 Tris 按在石墙上并质问她在那里做什么。
numbers: six o’clock（“he tells me it’s six o’clock—an hour after I first arrived in Erudite headquarters”——Shawn 告知的钟点）
an hour（同上句：在 Erudite 总部待了一小时）
the fourth car（“I run alongside the fourth car, since it’s the one that will have the factionless emergency bag inside it”——存有应急包的第四节车厢）
